text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the first Classic Triple Crown race, the Satsuki Sho, the crowd roars with anticipation to see the big three—Seiun Sky versus Special Week versus King Halo.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yet despite all this attention, Seiun Sky is almost late for the race because she was—of all things—petting a cat in a park!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still, she assures me that she's taking this seriously. She meets her opponents' intense gazes head on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But not before she sends a picture of the cat to her grandfather with the message, "I'm going to take home the Triple Crown."
